usage: analyze_expert_complementarity.py [-h] [--model MODEL] [--test TEST]
                                         [--trials TRIALS] [--seed SEED]
                                         [--tie-epsilon TIE_EPSILON]
                                         [--outdir OUTDIR]

Stage A: leakage-aware, held-out expert complementarity audit for TQHG-v2. No
training occurs and no model weights are altered. Uses the SAME held-out 24
glove records, explicit faulty masks, and seed scheme as the original
scripts/evaluate_tqhg_v2_faults.py. Distinguishes *sample oracle* (diagnostic
lower bound using ground-truth labels) from a deployable predictor. Without
MuJoCo, J=0, P=0 and N=I; this audits whole-control gating, NOT independent
task/null-space contributions. Small fixed-pose test; do not use sample-level
win rates as independent-trial hypothesis tests.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL
  --test TEST
  --trials TRIALS
  --seed SEED
  --tie-epsilon TIE_EPSILON
  --outdir OUTDIR
